item.title: uttero 0.1.7
item.description:
• Menu: install the Claude Code plugin when it is missing
  • Ship the core inside the app as one executable; publish downloads, feed and plugin from barockok/uttero
  • Manager as a fast dispatcher: background jobs, list_jobs, stop_session, shorter transcript wait
  • Voice setting applies from the next call, without a core restart
  • Timing log: speech text, delegation and hand-off to the manager, on stderr

item.title: uttero 0.1.6
item.description:
• In-app updates with Sparkle, published to the public uttero-releases feed
  • Release the mic when the wake phrase is off and no call is open
